opening.argument: This describes a straightforward wallet-promotion and referral incentive, not a deceptive payment flow. The speaker encourages viewers to get people into Bitcoin wallets, then explains that when someone deposits $100, they make $10 and the referrer makes $10 as well. That is a stated one-level reward tied to a specific wallet deposit. The Bitcoin price discussion is framed as a conditional adoption scenario, with the speaker saying “if it goes to 2% of the world using it 1 million dollars a coin,” rather than promising a guaranteed return. The supplied content does not request credentials or account control, and it does not show a deceptive payment process.
